title: FeatherSMP
description: NEW Hardcore server, FeatherHC(SMP) is looking for members. Maybe even you!
body:
**🪶 Welcome to FeatherSMP**

FeatherSMP is a high-stakes, story-driven survival experience inspired by the "unstable" genre of SMPs. We are building a world where every action has a consequence and every player helps weave the overarching narrative.

**⚖️ Why FeatherSMP?**

While inspired by the high-tension "unstable" format, FeatherSMP is a completely independent project. We focus on:

Narrative Integrity: Story first, always.

Community Respect: A professional environment for artists, builders, and players alike.

Active Development: Constant updates to keep the "unstable" elements fresh and exciting.
